title: Publish Web Recon & Security Info Tool to Production

requirements.summary: Publish the Web Recon & Security Info Tool application to production (mainnet)
acceptanceCriteria: The application is successfully deployed to the Internet Computer mainnet.
All existing features (domain scan form, results display, scan history, cybersecurity theme) remain functional after publishing.

file_operations.description: Update meta tags and any development-specific configurations for production deployment. Ensure the title 'Web Recon & Security Info Tool' and root mounting point remain unchanged.
Verify that the QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider are configured correctly for mainnet deployment. Ensure no development-only settings remain.
Confirm that the actor initialization uses the correct mainnet canister IDs and removes any local development network configurations.
Ensure Internet Identity authentication is configured for mainnet (identity.ic0.app) and remove any development identity provider URLs.
